video_title: What's Next for Giannis? Discussing the Blockbuster Trade & His Next Chapter in Miami

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the physical benefits of the weather in Miami
quotes.excerpt: I enjoy the weather, it's good for my joints.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: The next question was going to be, what about the weather?

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I'm not going to lie, I enjoy the weather, it's good for my joints.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: I told you, I go to the gym, I don't even stretch, I don't do nothing, I just give it to the court and just get going.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Yes, yes, yes, like when I wake up I feel it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: I feel like it's interesting because like people who don't put their bodies through that every day are probably just like, oh, yeah, I'm sure it's that much better. But it's interesting to hear your perspective on it.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the work ethic of NBA players and staff
quotes.excerpt: Nobody cheats. Nobody cheats, everybody works hard.
quotes.quote: Nobody cheats. Nobody cheats, everybody works hard. But not just the players, the staff. Everybody works hard. You see the coaches, early in the gym, in the treadmill. You see them working out, lifting weights, then you see the strength conditioning coach. They're lifting weights, they're running with us. They're coming in to work knowing they're going to work out with us.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo explains the 'Miami' workout routine
quotes.excerpt: They call them Miamis. When I was with the Bucks, it was like, you got to run two Miamis.
quotes.quote: After practice, which practice will probably be like an hour and a half, you got to run tens. Like in the light day you might run two. Two tens. And around the league, people don't know this, they're called Miamis. When I was with the Bucks, it was like, you got to run two Miamis, or one Miami. So when I came here I was like, okay, I have to run three Miamis today. It was like, Miami? No, you got to run three tens. I was like, no, they call them Miamis.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his intense competitive nature watching basketball
quotes.excerpt: I stopped watching because my palms were sweaty, I get like too intense, I'm very competitive.
quotes.quote: I stopped watching because I felt like when I was watching basketball, my palms were sweaty, I get like too intense, I'm very competitive. If somebody I'm watching a game and somebody like scores 40 and he leads his team to win, I'm like, okay, I got to go do the same. And I'm like sitting in my chair at 7:00 p.m., two days before the game, sweating, I'm like, I got to do the same, I got to go do it. And then I started realizing like you burn out.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the difficulty of recognizing new players in the league
quotes.excerpt: I got to a point that I didn't know who I was playing against.
quotes.quote: I got to a point that I didn't know who I was playing against. I see in the scouting report the names, I'm like, who's that? They were like, he's been in the league two years.
